403	            old = next((x["value"] for x in self.led.totals(self.county)
404	                        if (x["page"], x["block_id"], x["direction"], x["key"]) == (page, bid, "col", t["column"])), None)
405	            out.append({"entity": ("total", page, bid, "col", t["column"]), "old": old,
406	                        "new": ans["total"] if t["kind"] == "column" else ans["value"], "model": model,
407	                        "label": f"small total/{t['column']}"})
408	        if t["kind"] == "row_total":
409	            old = next((x["value"] for x in self.led.totals(self.county)
410	                        if (x["page"], x["block_id"], x["direction"], x["key"]) == (page, bid, "row", t["row"])), None)
411	            out.append({"entity": ("total", page, bid, "row", t["row"]), "old": old, "new": ans["value"],
412	                        "model": model, "label": f"row total/{t['row']}"})
413	        if t["kind"] == "grand":
414	            old = next((x["value"] for x in self.led.totals(self.county)
415	                        if (x["page"], x["block_id"], x["direction"], x["key"]) == (page, bid, "grand", "")), None)
416	            out.append({"entity": ("total", page, bid, "grand", ""), "old": old, "new": ans["value"], "model": model,
417	                        "label": "grand total"})
418	        return out

420	    def reread(self, item: Item, r: dict):
421	        t, dpi, model = r["target"], r["dpi"], r["model"]
422	        item.actions += 1
423	        why = self._refusal(item, t, model)
424	        if why:
425	            self.ev("refused", item=item.id, target=t, dpi=dpi, model=model, reason=why)
426	            item.history.append(f"asked for {_tdesc(t)} with {model}: refused ({why})")
427	            self.log(f"    refused: {why}")
428	            return
429	        self.n_crops += 1
430	        dest = self.crop_dir / f"reread-{self.n_crops:04d}-{item.block}.png"
431	        name = {"cell": "reread_cell", "column": "reread_column"}.get(t["kind"], "reread_total")
432	        cell_tag = f"{t.get('row', '')}/{t.get('column', '')}".strip("/") or None
433	        with tracing.trace(name, kind="TOOL", run=self.run_id, county=self.county, page=item.page, block=item.block,
434	                           cell=cell_tag, target=t["kind"], dpi=dpi, model=model) as sp:
435	            try:
436	                path, box = self.geo.crop(item.page, item.block, t, dpi, dest)
437	            except GeometryError as e:
438	                self.ev("refused", item=item.id, target=t, dpi=dpi, model=model, reason=f"no crop: {e}")
439	                item.history.append(f"asked for {_tdesc(t)}: no crop could be cut ({e})")
440	                return
441	            sp.set_attribute("crop_path", str(path))
442	            prompt = READ_PROMPTS[t["kind"]].format(**{"row": t.get("row"), "column": t.get("column")})
443	            ans = self.gw.ask_json(prompt, path, validate=read_validator(t["kind"]), model=model)
444	        ups = self._updates(item, t, ans, model)
445	        settle(self.led, self.county, ups, self.seen)
446	        for u in ups:
447	            self.seen.setdefault(u["entity"], []).append(u["new"])
448	        for u in ups:
449	            if u["entity"][0] == "cell":

451	        self.sync_status()
452	        with tracing.trace("check_sums", kind="TOOL", run=self.run_id, county=self.county, page=item.page,
453	                           block=item.block):
454	            me = self.item_check(item)
455	        ok = bool(me and me.ok)
456	        if model == WEAK and not ok:
457	            item.weak_failures += 1
458	        changes = [{"what": u["label"], "entity": list(u["entity"]), "old": u["old"], "new": u["new"],
459	                    "kept": u["kept"], "sums_hold_old": u.get("sums_hold_old"), "sums_hold_new": u.get("sums_hold_new")}
460	                   for u in ups]
461	        self.ev("reread", item=item.id, page=item.page, block=item.block, target=t, model=model, dpi=dpi, box=list(box),
462	                crop=str(path), changes=changes)
463	        self.ev("check", item=item.id, page=item.page, block=item.block, sum_kind=item.kind, key=item.key, ok=ok,
464	                computed=me.computed if me else None, printed=me.printed if me else None,
465	                failing_in_block=sum(1 for c in self.checks_now() if c.block_id == item.block and not c.ok))
466	        item.history.append(f"re-read {_tdesc(t)} at {dpi} dpi with {model}: " +
467	                            ("; ".join(f"{c['what']} {c['old']} -> {c['new']} ({'kept new' if c['kept'] == 'new' else 'kept old'})"
468	                                       for c in changes if c["old"] != c["new"]) or "read the same values") +
469	                            f"; this sum now {'holds' if ok else 'still fails'}")
470	        self.log(f"    {_tdesc(t)} {dpi} dpi {model}: {'holds' if ok else 'still fails'}")
471	
472	    # -- one item
473	    def stop(self, item, reason):
474	        me = self.item_check(item)
475	        marked = []
476	        if me and not me.ok and me.kind != "grand":
477	            by = {_ckey(c): c for c in self.led.cells(self.county)}
478	            for k, _ in me.terms:

491	        with tracing.trace("work_item", kind="TOOL", run=self.run_id, county=self.county, page=item.page,
492	                           block=item.block, item=item.id):

495	    def _work(self, item: Item):
496	        self.ev("item_start", item=item.id, page=item.page, block=item.block)
497	        while True:
498	            me = self.item_check(item)
499	            if me is None or me.ok:
500	                self.ev("item_end", item=item.id, result="holds")
501	                return
502	            if item.actions >= MAX_ACTIONS:
503	                self.stop(item, f"six actions used on this item and its sum still fails")
504	                self.ev("item_end", item=item.id, result="cannot_verify")
505	                return
506	            prompt = build_prompt(item, self.led, self.county)
507	            try:
508	                d = self.gw.ask_json(prompt, validate=decision_validator, model=WEAK)
509	            except ValueError as e:
510	                self.ev("decision", item=item.id, model=WEAK, error=str(e)[:200])
511	                self.stop(item, f"the model gave no usable action ({str(e)[:120]})")
512	                self.ev("item_end", item=item.id, result="cannot_verify")
513	                return
514	            self.ev("decision", item=item.id, model=WEAK, answer=d)
515	            if d["action"] == "cannot_verify":
516	                self.stop(item, str(d["reason"])[:300])
517	                self.ev("item_end", item=item.id, result="cannot_verify")
518	                return
519	            if d["action"] == "done":
520	                self.stop(item, "the model ended the item while its sum still fails")
521	                self.ev("item_end", item=item.id, result="cannot_verify")
522	                return
523	            for r in d["rereads"]:
524	                if item.actions >= MAX_ACTIONS:
525	                    break
526	                self.reread(item, r)
527	                me = self.item_check(item)
528	                if me is None or me.ok:
529	                    break

532	def _tdesc(t):
533	    return t["kind"] + "".join(f" {t[k]}" for k in ("row", "column") if k in t)
534

536	def work_list(chs, done_ids: set, given_up: set = frozenset()) -> list[Item]:
537	    """Failing sums, grouped by block (page order), rows then columns then the grand total within a block.
538	    A sum is left out when it was worked before or a cell on it is already cannot_verify (`given_up`): the sum
539	    cannot be made to hold without that cell, and the cells left on it are closed at the end."""
540	    items = [Item(c.kind, c.page, c.block_id, c.key) for c in chs if not c.ok and
541	             f"{c.kind}:{c.page}:{c.block_id}:{c.key}" not in done_ids and
542	             not (c.kind != "grand" and any(k in given_up for k, _ in c.terms))]
543	
544	    def block_no(b):
545	        return -1 if b in ("reg", "cast") else int(b.rsplit("-b", 1)[1])
546	    items.sort(key=lambda i: (i.page, block_no(i.block), ORDER[i.kind], i.key))
547	    return items

550	def close_county(county, gw, led, geo, *, run_id="", max_items=None, log=print, crop_dir=None) -> dict:
551	    """Work every failing sum of a county's ledger. Returns the summary figures (also written as events)."""
552	    t0 = time.time()
553	    c0, p0 = gw.calls, (gw.prompt_tokens, gw.completion_tokens, gw.cost)
554	    cl = Closer(county, gw, led, geo, run_id=run_id, crop_dir=crop_dir, log=log)
555	    before = count_failing(cl.checks_now())
556	    first = {_ckey(c): c["value"] for c in led.cells(county)}
557	    stopped = None
558	    done_ids = {json.loads(e["payload_json"])["item"] for e in led.events(county) if e["kind"] == "item_end"}
559	    cl.ev("close_start", failing_before=before)
560	    cl.sync_status()                       # cells whose sums already hold are accepted; a resumed run keeps its own
561	    worked = 0
562	    try:
563	        with tracing.trace("close_county", kind="AGENT", run=run_id, county=county):
564	            tried: set = set()
565	            while True:
566	                given_up = {_ckey(c) for c in led.cells(county) if c["status"] == "cannot_verify"}
567	                todo = [i for i in work_list(cl.checks_now(), done_ids, given_up) if i.id not in tried]
568	                if not todo:
569	                    _finish_open_cells(cl)
570	                    break
571	                if max_items is not None and worked >= max_items:
572	                    break
573	                item = todo[0]
574	                tried.add(item.id)
575	                worked += 1
576	                log(f"item {worked}: {item.id}")
577	                cl.work(item)
578	                done_ids.add(item.id)
579	    except BudgetExceeded as e:
580	        stopped = str(e)
581	        log(f"stopped: {e}")
582	        cl.ev("stop", item=None, reason=stopped, cells=[])
583	    after = count_failing(cl.checks_now())
584	    cells = led.cells(county)
585	    s = {"county": county, "run_id": run_id, "items_worked": worked,
586	         "sums_failing_before": before, "sums_failing_after": after,
587	         "cells_reread": len(cl.reread_cells),
588	         "cells_changed": sum(1 for c in cells if c["value"] != first.get(_ckey(c))),
589	         "cells_total": len(cells), "cells_accepted": sum(c["status"] == "accepted" for c in cells),
590	         "cells_cannot_verify": sum(c["status"] == "cannot_verify" for c in cells),
591	         "cells_open": sum(c["status"] not in ("accepted", "cannot_verify") for c in cells),
592	         "model_calls": gw.calls - c0, "prompt_tokens": gw.prompt_tokens - p0[0],
593	         "completion_tokens": gw.completion_tokens - p0[1], "metered_cost_estimate": round(gw.cost - p0[2], 4),
594	         "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 1), "stopped": stopped}
595	    cl.ev("close_end", summary=s)
596	    return s

599	def _finish_open_cells(cl: Closer):
600	    """After every failing sum has been worked: a cell still not accepted is on no failing sum that can be worked
601	    (it sits on no printed sum, or its sums were already given up on). It becomes cannot_verify."""
602	    cells, totals = cl.led.cells(cl.county), cl.led.totals(cl.county)
603	    on = checks.crossing(cells, totals)
604	    for c in cells:
605	        if c["status"] in ("accepted", "cannot_verify"):
606	            continue
607	        cs = on.get(_ckey(c), [])
608	        reason = "no printed sum covers this cell" if not cs else "a sum it sits on still fails and was given up on"
609	        cl.led.set_status(cl.county, c["page"], c["block_id"], c["row_kind"], c["column"], "cannot_verify", reason)
610	        cl.ev("status_change", changes=[{"cell": list(_ckey(c)), "old": c["status"], "new": "cannot_verify",
611	                                         "reason": reason}])

"""Command-line entry point."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys

from . import sources
from .render import RenderError, page_png


def _counties(args) -> list[str]:
    if getattr(args, "all", False):
        return list(sources.COUNTIES)
    return [args.county]


def cmd_fetch(args) -> int:
    rc = 0
    for key in _counties(args):
        try:
            got = sources.fetch(key)
            print(f"{key}: downloaded {', '.join(got)}" if got else f"{key}: cached, nothing downloaded")
        except sources.FetchError as e:
            print(f"{key}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
            rc = 1
    return rc


def cmd_filecheck(args) -> int:
    rc = 0
    for key in _counties(args):
        try:
            sources.fetch(key)
        except sources.FetchError as e:
            print(f"{key}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
            rc = 1
            continue
        bad, checked, skipped = sources.file_mismatches(sources.read_published(key))
        print(f"{key}: {len(bad)} row(s) differ, {checked} checked, {skipped} skipped (blank part)")
        for r in bad:
            print(f"  {r['precinct']} | {r['office']} | {r['candidate']}: votes={r['votes']} "
                  f"but absentee+early_voting+election_day={r['parts_sum']}")
    return rc


def cmd_render(args) -> int:
    try:
        sources.fetch(args.county)
        from PIL import Image
        out = page_png(args.county, args.page, args.dpi)
        with Image.open(out) as im:
            print(f"{out} {im.width}x{im.height} px")
    except (RenderError, sources.FetchError) as e:
        print(e, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    return 0


def cmd_budget(args) -> int:
    from .model import gateway_spend
    try:
        spend, limit = gateway_spend()
    except (KeyError, OSError, ValueError) as e:
        print(f"cannot read the gateway's spend: {type(e).__name__} (is LITELLM_BASE_URL / LITELLM_API_KEY set?)",
              file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    print(f"gateway spend so far: ${spend:.4f}; limit: " + (f"${limit:.2f}" if limit is not None else "none"))
    return 0


def cmd_read(args) -> int:
    import json
    import time
    from pathlib import Path

    from . import tracing
    from .ledger import Ledger
    from .layouts import matrix
    from .model import Gateway, gateway_spend
    note = tracing.init()
    if note:
        print(note)
    if args.county != "panola":
        print(f"{args.county}: only the matrix layout (panola) is built so far", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    try:
        sources.fetch(args.county)
    except sources.FetchError as e:
        print(e, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    try:
        before = gateway_spend()[0]
    except (KeyError, OSError, ValueError):
        before = None
    run_id = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
    out = Path("runs") / run_id
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    led = Ledger(out / "ledger.sqlite")
    gw = Gateway(budget=args.budget)
    pages = [int(x) for x in args.pages.split(",")] if args.pages else None
    print(f"run {run_id}: reading {args.county} with {gw.model}, run budget ${args.budget:.2f}")
    try:
        s = matrix.read_county(args.county, gw, led, run_id=run_id, pages=pages)
    except (RenderError, RuntimeError) as e:
        print(e, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    finally:
        tracing.shutdown()
    try:
        s["gateway_spend_before"], s["gateway_spend_after"] = before, gateway_spend()[0]

"""SQLite ledger: cells, printed totals and events for one run. Resume keeps accepted cells."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sqlite3
import time
from pathlib import Path

SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cells(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, county TEXT, page INTEGER, block_id TEXT, contest TEXT, candidate TEXT,
  row_kind TEXT, column TEXT, value INTEGER, first_read INTEGER, status TEXT DEFAULT 'first_read',
  tries INTEGER DEFAULT 0, model TEXT, x0 INTEGER, y0 INTEGER, x1 INTEGER, y1 INTEGER, reason TEXT,
  UNIQUE(county, page, block_id, row_kind, column));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS totals(
  county TEXT, page INTEGER, block_id TEXT, direction TEXT, key TEXT, value INTEGER,
  UNIQUE(county, page, block_id, direction, key));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ts REAL, county TEXT, kind TEXT, payload_json TEXT);
"""
STATUSES = ("first_read", "accepted", "failed", "cannot_verify")


class Ledger:
    """One SQLite file. Cells are keyed by (county, page, block_id, row_kind, column)."""

    def __init__(self, path: str | Path = ":memory:"):
        self.db = sqlite3.connect(str(path))
        self.db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        self.db.executescript(SCHEMA)
        if "reason" not in {r["name"] for r in self.db.execute("PRAGMA table_info(cells)")}:
            self.db.execute("ALTER TABLE cells ADD COLUMN reason TEXT")  # ledgers made before the loop existed

    def close(self):
        self.db.close()

    def put_cell(self, county, page, block_id, row_kind, column, value, *, contest=None, candidate=None,
                 model=None, box=(None, None, None, None)):
        """Insert a first read, or re-read an open cell. An accepted cell is never overwritten (resume)."""
        self.db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO cells(county,page,block_id,contest,candidate,row_kind,column,value,first_read,model,x0,y0,x1,y1)"
            " VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)"
            " ON CONFLICT(county,page,block_id,row_kind,column) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value,"
            " tries=tries+1, model=excluded.model WHERE status!='accepted'",
            (county, page, block_id, contest, candidate, row_kind, column, value, value, model, *box))
        self.db.commit()

    def set_status(self, county, page, block_id, row_kind, column, status, reason=None):
        if status not in STATUSES:
            raise ValueError(f"unknown status {status!r}")
        self.db.execute("UPDATE cells SET status=?, reason=? WHERE county=? AND page=? AND block_id=? AND row_kind=? "
                        "AND column=?", (status, reason, county, page, block_id, row_kind, column))
        self.db.commit()

    def reread_cell(self, county, page, block_id, row_kind, column, value, model=None):
        """Record one re-read of a cell: tries goes up by one, the value is the one kept, the model only if it changed it."""
        self.db.execute("UPDATE cells SET value=?, tries=tries+1, model=COALESCE(?, model) WHERE county=? AND page=? "
                        "AND block_id=? AND row_kind=? AND column=? AND status!='accepted'",
                        (value, model, county, page, block_id, row_kind, column))
        self.db.commit()

    def put_total(self, county, page, block_id, direction, key, value):
        self.db.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO totals VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                        (county, page, block_id, direction, key, value))
        self.db.commit()

    def event(self, county, kind, payload=None):
        self.db.execute("INSERT INTO events(ts,county,kind,payload_json) VALUES(?,?,?,?)",
                        (time.time(), county, kind, json.dumps(payload or {})))
        self.db.commit()

    def cells(self, county=None, status=None) -> list[dict]:
        q, a = "SELECT * FROM cells WHERE 1=1", []
        if county:
            q += " AND county=?"; a.append(county)
        if status:
            q += " AND status=?"; a.append(status)
        return [dict(r) for r in self.db.execute(q + " ORDER BY id", a)]

    def totals(self, county=None) -> list[dict]:
        q, a = "SELECT * FROM totals", []
        if county:
            q += " WHERE county=?"; a.append(county)
        return [dict(r) for r in self.db.execute(q, a)]

    def events(self, county=None) -> list[dict]:
        q, a = "SELECT * FROM events", []
        if county:
            q += " WHERE county=?"; a.append(county)
        return [dict(r) for r in self.db.execute(q + " ORDER BY id", a)]

    def open_cells(self, county=None) -> list[dict]:
        """Cells that still need work: first_read or failed."""
        return [c for c in self.cells(county) if c["status"] in ("first_read", "failed")]
"""Files a run leaves behind: `county.json` and `run.json`.

runs/<run_id>/<county>/county.json
  county, run_id, layout            names the county, the run and the layout ("matrix")
  pages     [{number, width, height, dpi}]   image size at the dpi the boxes use (200)
  blocks    [{id, page, contest, candidate, box}]          box = [x0, y0, x1, y1] in pixels of that image, or null

  checks    [{kind, page, block, key, terms, printed, computed, ok}]    terms = [[[page, block, row_kind, column], value]]
  events    [{ts, kind, payload}]    in order: item_start, decision, reread, check, status_change, refused, stop, item_end
  summary   sums failing before and after, cells re-read / changed / cannot_verify, model calls, tokens, metered cost,
            seconds (the figures of the close)
runs/<run_id>/run.json
  run_id, started, ended, commit, command, counties, model_calls, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens,
  metered_cost_estimate
"""

from PIL import Image

from . import checks

LAYOUT = "matrix"
GEO_DPI = 200


def _page_sizes(county, pages, root):
    from .render import page_png
    out = []
    for n in pages:
        try:
            with Image.open(page_png(county, n, GEO_DPI, root)) as im:
                out.append({"number": n, "width": im.width, "height": im.height, "dpi": GEO_DPI})
        except Exception:
            out.append({"number": n, "width": None, "height": None, "dpi": GEO_DPI})
    return out


def write_county(run_dir, county, run_id, led, geo, summary, *, pages=None, data_root=None) -> Path:
    cells, totals = led.cells(county), led.totals(county)
    if pages is None:
        pages = sorted({c["page"] for c in cells})
    box = lambda c: [c[k] for k in ("x0", "y0", "x1", "y1")] if c["x0"] is not None else None
    seen, blocks = set(), []
    for c in cells:
        k = (c["page"], c["block_id"])
        if k not in seen:
            seen.add(k)
            bb = geo.block_box(*k) if geo else None
            blocks.append({"id": c["block_id"], "page": c["page"], "contest": c["contest"],
                           "candidate": c["candidate"], "box": list(bb) if bb else None})
    chs = [{"kind": ch.kind, "page": ch.page, "block": ch.block_id, "key": ch.key,
            "terms": [[list(k), v] for k, v in ch.terms], "printed": ch.printed, "computed": ch.computed, "ok": ch.ok}
           for ch in checks.all_checks(cells, totals)]
    tbox = lambda t: (lambda b: list(b) if b else None)(
        geo.total_box(t["page"], t["block_id"], t["direction"], t["key"]) if geo else None)
    d = {"county": county, "run_id": run_id, "layout": LAYOUT,
         "pages": _page_sizes(county, pages, data_root) if pages else [],
         "blocks": blocks,
         "cells": [{"page": c["page"], "block": c["block_id"], "contest": c["contest"], "candidate": c["candidate"],
                    "row_kind": c["row_kind"], "column": c["column"], "value": c["value"],
                    "first_read": c["first_read"], "status": c["status"], "tries": c["tries"], "model": c["model"],
                    "reason": c.get("reason"), "box": box(c)} for c in cells],
         "totals": [{"page": t["page"], "block": t["block_id"], "direction": t["direction"], "key": t["key"],
                     "value": t["value"], "box": tbox(t)} for t in totals],
         "checks": chs,
         "events": [{"ts": e["ts"], "kind": e["kind"], "payload": json.loads(e["payload_json"])}
                    for e in led.events(county)],
         "summary": summary}
    out = Path(run_dir) / county / "county.json"
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(json.dumps(d, indent=1))
    return out


def git_commit() -> str | None:
    try:
        return subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
    except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
        return None


def write_run(run_dir, run_id, *, started, ended, command, counties, gw, resumed_from=None) -> Path:
    d = {"run_id": run_id, "started": started, "ended": ended, "commit": git_commit(), "command": command,
         "counties": counties, "resumed_from": resumed_from, "model_calls": gw.calls,
         "prompt_tokens": gw.prompt_tokens, "completion_tokens": gw.completion_tokens,
         "metered_cost_estimate": round(gw.cost, 4)}
    out = Path(run_dir) / "run.json"
    out.write_text(json.dumps(d, indent=1))
    return out

def main(argv=None) -> int:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="crossfoot")
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    for name, fn, h in (("fetch", cmd_fetch, "download a county's scan and published file"),
                        ("filecheck", cmd_filecheck, "list published rows whose votes differ from their parts")):
        s = sub.add_parser(name, help=h)
        g = s.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
        g.add_argument("--county", choices=list(sources.COUNTIES))
        g.add_argument("--all", action="store_true")
        s.set_defaults(fn=fn)
    s = sub.add_parser("render", help="render one scan page to PNG")
    s.add_argument("--county", required=True, choices=list(sources.COUNTIES))
    s.add_argument("--page", type=int, required=True)
    s.add_argument("--dpi", type=int, default=200)
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_render)
    s = sub.add_parser("read", help="first read of a county's scan into a new run's ledger")
    s.add_argument("--county", required=True, choices=list(sources.COUNTIES))
    s.add_argument("--budget", type=float, default=2.00, help="dollars this run may meter (default 2.00)")
    s.add_argument("--pages", help="comma-separated pages, default all")
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_read)
    s = sub.add_parser("close", help="work every failing sum of a first-read ledger until each cell is accepted or "
                                     "cannot_verify")
    s.add_argument("--county", required=True, choices=list(sources.COUNTIES))
    s.add_argument("--resume", required=True, help="run id whose ledger is copied into a new run")
    s.add_argument("--budget", type=float, default=1.50, help="dollars this run may meter (default 1.50)")
    s.add_argument("--max-items", type=int, help="work at most this many failing sums (for trials)")
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_close)
    s = sub.add_parser("budget", help="print the gateway's spend and limit for the key")
    s.set_defaults(fn=cmd_budget)
    args = p.parse_args(argv)
    return args.fn(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
"""SQLite ledger: cells, printed totals and events for one run. Resume keeps accepted cells."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sqlite3
import time
from pathlib import Path

SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cells(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, county TEXT, page INTEGER, block_id TEXT, contest TEXT, candidate TEXT,
  row_kind TEXT, column TEXT, value INTEGER, first_read INTEGER, status TEXT DEFAULT 'first_read',
  tries INTEGER DEFAULT 0, model TEXT, x0 INTEGER, y0 INTEGER, x1 INTEGER, y1 INTEGER, reason TEXT,
  UNIQUE(county, page, block_id, row_kind, column));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS totals(
  county TEXT, page INTEGER, block_id TEXT, direction TEXT, key TEXT, value INTEGER,
  UNIQUE(county, page, block_id, direction, key));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ts REAL, county TEXT, kind TEXT, payload_json TEXT);
"""
STATUSES = ("first_read", "accepted", "failed", "cannot_verify")


class Ledger:
    """One SQLite file. Cells are keyed by (county, page, block_id, row_kind, column)."""

    def __init__(self, path: str | Path = ":memory:"):
        self.db = sqlite3.connect(str(path))
        self.db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        self.db.executescript(SCHEMA)
        if "reason" not in {r["name"] for r in self.db.execute("PRAGMA table_info(cells)")}:
            self.db.execute("ALTER TABLE cells ADD COLUMN reason TEXT")  # ledgers made before the loop existed

    def close(self):
        self.db.close()

    def put_cell(self, county, page, block_id, row_kind, column, value, *, contest=None, candidate=None,
                 model=None, box=(None, None, None, None)):
        """Insert a first read, or re-read an open cell. An accepted cell is never overwritten (resume)."""
        self.db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO cells(county,page,block_id,contest,candidate,row_kind,column,value,first_read,model,x0,y0,x1,y1)"
            " VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)"
            " ON CONFLICT(county,page,block_id,row_kind,column) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value,"
            " tries=tries+1, model=excluded.model WHERE status!='accepted'",
            (county, page, block_id, contest, candidate, row_kind, column, value, value, model, *box))
        self.db.commit()

    def set_status(self, county, page, block_id, row_kind, column, status, reason=None):
        if status not in STATUSES:
            raise ValueError(f"unknown status {status!r}")
        self.db.execute("UPDATE cells SET status=?, reason=? WHERE county=? AND page=? AND block_id=? AND row_kind=? "
                        "AND column=?", (status, reason, county, page, block_id, row_kind, column))
        self.db.commit()

    def reread_cell(self, county, page, block_id, row_kind, column, value, model=None):
        """Record one re-read of a cell: tries goes up by one, the value is the one kept, the model only if it changed it."""
        self.db.execute("UPDATE cells SET value=?, tries=tries+1, model=COALESCE(?, model) WHERE county=? AND page=? "
                        "AND block_id=? AND row_kind=? AND column=? AND status!='accepted'",
                        (value, model, county, page, block_id, row_kind, column))
        self.db.commit()

    def put_total(self, county, page, block_id, direction, key, value):
        self.db.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO totals VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                        (county, page, block_id, direction, key, value))
        self.db.commit()

    def event(self, county, kind, payload=None):
        self.db.execute("INSERT INTO events(ts,county,kind,payload_json) VALUES(?,?,?,?)",
                        (time.time(), county, kind, json.dumps(payload or {})))
        self.db.commit()

    def cells(self, county=None, status=None) -> list[dict]:
        q, a = "SELECT * FROM cells WHERE 1=1", []
        if county:
            q += " AND county=?"; a.append(county)
        if status:
            q += " AND status=?"; a.append(status)
        return [dict(r) for r in self.db.execute(q + " ORDER BY id", a)]

    def totals(self, county=None) -> list[dict]:
        q, a = "SELECT * FROM totals", []
        if county:
            q += " WHERE county=?"; a.append(county)
        return [dict(r) for r in self.db.execute(q, a)]

    def events(self, county=None) -> list[dict]:
        q, a = "SELECT * FROM events", []
        if county:
            q += " WHERE county=?"; a.append(county)
        return [dict(r) for r in self.db.execute(q + " ORDER BY id", a)]

    def open_cells(self, county=None) -> list[dict]:
        """Cells that still need work: first_read or failed."""
        return [c for c in self.cells(county) if c["status"] in ("first_read", "failed")]
"""Files a run leaves behind: `county.json` and `run.json`.

runs/<run_id>/<county>/county.json
  county, run_id, layout            names the county, the run and the layout ("matrix")
  pages     [{number, width, height, dpi}]   image size at the dpi the boxes use (200)
  blocks    [{id, page, contest, candidate, box}]          box = [x0, y0, x1, y1] in pixels of that image, or null
  cells     [{page, block, contest, candidate, row_kind, column, value, first_read, status, tries, model, reason, box}]
            status is accepted or cannot_verify when the run is closed; first_read is what the first read gave
  totals    [{page, block, direction, key, value, box}]    direction row (key = row kind), col (key = precinct), grand
  checks    [{kind, page, block, key, terms, printed, computed, ok}]    terms = [[[page, block, row_kind, column], value]]
  events    [{ts, kind, payload}]    in order: item_start, decision, reread, check, status_change, refused, stop, item_end
  summary   sums failing before and after, cells re-read / changed / cannot_verify, model calls, tokens, metered cost,
            seconds (the figures of the close)
runs/<run_id>/run.json
  run_id, started, ended, commit, command, counties, model_calls, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens,
  metered_cost_estimate
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image

from . import checks

LAYOUT = "matrix"
GEO_DPI = 200


def _page_sizes(county, pages, root):
    from .render import page_png
    out = []
    for n in pages:
        try:
            with Image.open(page_png(county, n, GEO_DPI, root)) as im:
                out.append({"number": n, "width": im.width, "height": im.height, "dpi": GEO_DPI})
        except Exception:
            out.append({"number": n, "width": None, "height": None, "dpi": GEO_DPI})
    return out


def write_county(run_dir, county, run_id, led, geo, summary, *, pages=None, data_root=None) -> Path:
    cells, totals = led.cells(county), led.totals(county)
    if pages is None:
        pages = sorted({c["page"] for c in cells})
    box = lambda c: [c[k] for k in ("x0", "y0", "x1", "y1")] if c["x0"] is not None else None
    seen, blocks = set(), []
    for c in cells:
        k = (c["page"], c["block_id"])
        if k not in seen:
            seen.add(k)
            bb = geo.block_box(*k) if geo else None
            blocks.append({"id": c["block_id"], "page": c["page"], "contest": c["contest"],
                           "candidate": c["candidate"], "box": list(bb) if bb else None})
    chs = [{"kind": ch.kind, "page": ch.page, "block": ch.block_id, "key": ch.key,
            "terms": [[list(k), v] for k, v in ch.terms], "printed": ch.printed, "computed": ch.computed, "ok": ch.ok}
           for ch in checks.all_checks(cells, totals)]
    tbox = lambda t: (lambda b: list(b) if b else None)(
        geo.total_box(t["page"], t["block_id"], t["direction"], t["key"]) if geo else None)
    d = {"county": county, "run_id": run_id, "layout": LAYOUT,
         "pages": _page_sizes(county, pages, data_root) if pages else [],
         "blocks": blocks,
         "cells": [{"page": c["page"], "block": c["block_id"], "contest": c["contest"], "candidate": c["candidate"],
                    "row_kind": c["row_kind"], "column": c["column"], "value": c["value"],
                    "first_read": c["first_read"], "status": c["status"], "tries": c["tries"], "model": c["model"],
                    "reason": c.get("reason"), "box": box(c)} for c in cells],
         "totals": [{"page": t["page"], "block": t["block_id"], "direction": t["direction"], "key": t["key"],
                     "value": t["value"], "box": tbox(t)} for t in totals],
         "checks": chs,
         "events": [{"ts": e["ts"], "kind": e["kind"], "payload": json.loads(e["payload_json"])}
                    for e in led.events(county)],
         "summary": summary}
    out = Path(run_dir) / county / "county.json"
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(json.dumps(d, indent=1))
    return out


def git_commit() -> str | None:
    try:
        return subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
    except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
        return None


def write_run(run_dir, run_id, *, started, ended, command, counties, gw, resumed_from=None) -> Path:
    d = {"run_id": run_id, "started": started, "ended": ended, "commit": git_commit(), "command": command,
         "counties": counties, "resumed_from": resumed_from, "model_calls": gw.calls,
         "prompt_tokens": gw.prompt_tokens, "completion_tokens": gw.completion_tokens,
         "metered_cost_estimate": round(gw.cost, 4)}
    out = Path(run_dir) / "run.json"
    out.write_text(json.dumps(d, indent=1))
    return out

# First read of Panola: before and after (T02a)

## What failed
The first read (T02) sent one crop per block, about 2,600 px wide, to `claude-haiku`. 91 of 130 row sums, 203 of 768
column sums and 35 of 43 grand totals did not add up to the totals printed on the page.

## What shows the cause
- Trace `c0ad0dc20af3f7651960204384229937` (root span `read_county`, 2026-10-11T09:03Z, run `20261011-090307`).
  The neatlogs MCP server could list it (`search_traces`, query `read_block`), but `get_trace_context` answered
  `not_enabled` (server message: disabled until NL-1924 is rolled out), so no model span could be opened. The
  figures below come from the run's own files instead: `runs/20261011-090307/first-read.json`,
  `ledger.sqlite` and `crops/`.
- Prompt tokens: 25,705 over 43 calls, about 598 per call, for images 2,614 px wide. That is far fewer tokens than a
  full-size image of that width would cost, so the provider shrinks it before the model sees it (an inference from
  the token count, not a measurement of the provider).
- Block `p2-b2` (crop `runs/20261011-090307/crops/p2-b2.png`, read by eye): the only non-zero cell is a 2 in the
  PRECINCT row of the seventh precinct column; the small total under that column is 2. The ledger holds that 2 in the
  nineteenth (last) column and 0 under the seventh, so a value lost its column position in the wide image.
- Digits in the 200 dpi crop are about 10 px tall.

## The change (commit `338de15`)
- A block is cut into column groups along the column lines, each image at most 1,500 px wide at 300 dpi (digits
  about 16 px tall). The first group carries the row labels (candidate name), the last carries the TOTAL column;
  rows are named in order EARLY, ABSENTEE, PRECINCT and each group is told which precincts it holds. Answers are
  joined left to right (`plan_groups`, `merge_groups`; tests in `tests/test_groups.py` check every column is
  covered once and values stay with their precinct and row).
- Found on the way: `_edges` took the left edge of the row-label box as the first precinct edge, so every column
  was one off. The first fixed-size attempt (`runs/20261011-092655`, not committed) lost the precinct 8 column
  because of it (cells 2,212; row sums 52 pass / 78 fail). Fixed in `_edges`, which also corrects the cell boxes.
- Each group call is a span `read_group` with block id, column range, crop width and height, dpi and its estimated
  cost. The header block (page 1, first block) still goes as one wide crop; it was not changed.

- Worse: three times the calls, about 2.1 times the cost and 1.8 times the time.

75	def plan_groups(edges, label_x0, total_x1, *, scale, max_w) -> list[Group]:
76	    """Cut the columns (n+1 edges) into runs whose image, with labels in the first and TOTAL in the last, fits max_w."""
77	    n = len(edges) - 1
78	    label_w = (edges[0] - label_x0) * scale
79	    total_w = (total_x1 - edges[n]) * scale
80	    out, c = [], 0
81	    while c < n:
82	        first = c == 0
83	        w = label_w if first else 0.0
84	        c1 = c
85	        while c1 < n:
86	            nw = w + (edges[c1 + 1] - edges[c1]) * scale
87	            last_extra = total_w if c1 + 1 == n else 0.0
88	            if c1 > c and nw + last_extra > max_w:
89	                break
90	            w, c1 = nw, c1 + 1
91	        last = c1 == n
92	        out.append(Group(c, c1, first, last, w + (total_w if last else 0.0)))
93	        c = c1
94	    return out

105	def group_image(hi_png, b, edges, g, scale, dest: Path) -> Path:
106	    """Stitch the strips of one group side by side: labels | columns | TOTAL, all the block's full height."""
107	    y0, y1 = round(b.y0 * scale), round(b.y1 * scale)
108	    xs = [(b.x0, edges[0])] if g.labels else []
109	    xs.append((edges[g.c0], edges[g.c1]))
110	    if g.total:
111	        xs.append((edges[-1], b.x1))
112	    with Image.open(hi_png) as im:
113	        strips = [im.crop((round(a * scale), y0, round(z * scale), y1)) for a, z in xs]
114	    out = Image.new(strips[0].mode, (sum(s.width for s in strips), y1 - y0), 255)
115	    x = 0
116	    for s in strips:
117	        out.paste(s, (x, 0))
118	        x += s.width
119	    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
120	    out.save(dest)

355	        i = 0 if bid in ("reg", "cast") else int(bid.rsplit("-b", 1)[1])
356	        if i >= len(blocks) or edges is None:
357	            raise GeometryError(f"no column lines found for {bid} on page {page}")
358	        rows = HEADER_ROWS if bid in ("reg", "cast") else ROWS
359	        self._cur_page = page
360	        self._rules(blocks[i], edges)
361	        return blocks[i], edges, rows

363	    def _rules(self, b, edges):
364	        """y of each horizontal rule across the precinct columns inside the block's ruled height, found in the image."""
365	        key = (b.y0, b.x0)
366	        if key not in self._rule_cache:
367	            import numpy as np
368	            png = page_png(self.county, self._cur_page, GEO_DPI, self.root)
369	            with Image.open(png) as im:

371	            cover = (g < 110).mean(axis=1) >= 0.6
372	            ys = []

381	        h = (b.rule_y1 - b.rule_y0) / len(rows)
382	
383	        def edge(j):    # an even split, moved onto a drawn rule when one lies within 5 px
384	            y = b.rule_y0 + j * h
385	            near = min(ys, key=lambda r: abs(r - y), default=None)
386	            return round(near if near is not None and abs(near - y) <= 5 else y)
387	        return edge(i), edge(i + 1)

398	        ci = self.cols.index(col)

403	            b, edges, rows = self._block(page, bid)
404	            n = len(self.cols)
405	            if direction == "row":
406	                y0, y1 = self._row(b, rows, key)
407	                return (edges[n], y0, b.x1, y1)
408	            if bid == "reg":
409	                return None
410	            if direction == "col":
411	                ci = self.cols.index(key)
412	                if bid == "cast":
413	                    y0, y1 = self._row(b, rows, "SMALL")
414	                    return (edges[ci], y0, edges[ci + 1], y1)
415	                return (edges[ci], b.rule_y1, edges[ci + 1], min(b.y1, b.rule_y1 + SMALL_ROW))
416	            if bid == "cast":

418	                return (edges[n], y0, b.x1, b.y1)

420	        except (GeometryError, ValueError):

424	        """The box of a re-read target, without padding."""
425	        b, edges, rows = self._block(page, bid)
426	        kind = t["kind"]

"""The investigation loop's rules, with a fake model and a fake page. No network, no images of real scans."""
import json

import pytest
from PIL import Image

from crossfoot import agent, outputs, tracing
from crossfoot.ledger import Ledger

ROWS = ("EARLY", "ABSENTEE", "PRECINCT")
GOOD = {"1": (10, 2, 3), "2": (20, 4, 6)}     # column -> EARLY, ABSENTEE, PRECINCT
HAIKU, SONNET = "claude-haiku", "claude-sonnet-4.6"


def make_block(led, page, bid, good=GOOD, wrong=None, row_totals=None, col_totals=None, grand=None):
    """A block whose printed totals are those of `good`; `wrong` maps (row, column) -> the value the first read gave."""
    wrong = wrong or {}
    for col, vals in good.items():
        for r, v in zip(ROWS, vals):
            led.put_cell("x", page, bid, r, col, wrong.get((r, col), v), contest="C", candidate=f"cand {bid}")
        led.put_total("x", page, bid, "col", col, (col_totals or {}).get(col, sum(vals)))
    for i, r in enumerate(ROWS):
        led.put_total("x", page, bid, "row", r, (row_totals or {}).get(r, sum(v[i] for v in good.values())))
    led.put_total("x", page, bid, "grand", "", grand if grand is not None else sum(sum(v) for v in good.values()))


class FakeGeo:
    def __init__(self):
        self.targets = []

    def crop(self, page, bid, target, dpi, dest):
        self.targets.append((bid, dict(target), dpi))
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        Image.new("L", (10, 10), 255).save(dest)
        return dest, (0, 0, 10, 10)

    def total_box(self, page, bid, direction, key):
        return None

    def block_box(self, page, bid):
        return None


class FakeGw:
    """Decisions come from `decide(prompt, n)`, re-reads from `read(target, model, n)`. Logs every call."""
    def __init__(self, geo, decide, read, model=HAIKU):
        self.geo, self.decide, self.read, self.model = geo, decide, read, model
        self.calls = self.prompt_tokens = self.completion_tokens = 0
        self.cost = 0.0
        self.log = []

    def ask_json(self, prompt, image=None, *, validate=None, model=None):
        self.calls += 1
        model = model or self.model
        if image is None:
            ans = self.decide(prompt, sum(1 for m, k, _ in self.log if k == "decide"))
            self.log.append((model, "decide", prompt))
        else:
            bid, target, dpi = self.geo.targets[-1]
            ans = self.read(bid, target, model, sum(1 for m, k, _ in self.log if k == "read"))
            self.log.append((model, "read", (bid, target, dpi)))
        if validate:
            validate(ans)
        return ans


def reread_col(col, model=HAIKU, dpi=300):
    return {"action": "reread", "rereads": [{"target": {"kind": "column", "column": col}, "dpi": dpi, "model": model}]}


def truth_reader(good=GOOD):
    def read(bid, t, model, n):
        if t["kind"] == "column":
            e, a, p = good[t["column"]]
            return {"EARLY": e, "ABSENTEE": a, "PRECINCT": p, "total": e + a + p}
        if t["kind"] == "cell":
            return {"value": good[t["column"]][ROWS.index(t["row"])]}
        raise AssertionError(t)
    return read


def run(led, decide, read, **kw):
    geo = FakeGeo()
    gw = FakeGw(geo, decide, read)
    s = agent.close_county("x", gw, led, geo, run_id="", log=lambda *a: None, **kw)
    return s, gw, geo


def assert_status_rule(led):
    """AC-1: no accepted cell sits on a failing printed sum, and every cell ends accepted or cannot_verify."""
    from crossfoot import checks
    cells, totals = led.cells("x"), led.totals("x")
    bad = {k for ch in checks.row_checks(cells, totals) + checks.column_checks(cells, totals) if not ch.ok
           for k, _ in ch.terms}
    for c in cells:
        assert c["status"] in ("accepted", "cannot_verify"), c
        if c["status"] == "accepted":
            assert checks.cell_key(c) not in bad


def test_closes_a_misread_cell_and_records_both_readings():
    led = Ledger()
    make_block(led, 1, "p1-b1", wrong={("EARLY", "1"): 16})
    s, gw, geo = run(led, lambda p, n: reread_col("1"), truth_reader())
    assert_status_rule(led)
    assert {c["status"] for c in led.cells("x")} == {"accepted"}
    cell = next(c for c in led.cells("x") if c["row_kind"] == "EARLY" and c["column"] == "1")
    assert (cell["value"], cell["first_read"]) == (10, 16)
    ev = [e for e in led.events("x") if e["kind"] == "reread"]
    p = json.loads(ev[0]["payload_json"])
    assert p["changes"][0]["old"] == 16 and p["changes"][0]["new"] == 10 and p["model"] == HAIKU and p["dpi"] == 300
    kinds = [e["kind"] for e in led.events("x")]
    assert kinds.index("decision") < kinds.index("reread") < kinds.index("check")
    assert s["cells_changed"] == 1 and s["sums_failing_before"]["row"] == 1 and s["sums_failing_after"]["row"] == 0


def test_a_worse_reading_is_not_kept():
    led = Ledger()
    make_block(led, 1, "p1-b1", wrong={("EARLY", "1"): 16})
    # first the re-read makes it worse (EARLY 99), then it is right
    def read(bid, t, model, n):
        e, a, p = GOOD[t["column"]]
        return {"EARLY": 99 if n == 0 else e, "ABSENTEE": a, "PRECINCT": p, "total": e + a + p}
    s, gw, geo = run(led, lambda p, n: reread_col("1"), read)
    ev = [json.loads(e["payload_json"]) for e in led.events("x") if e["kind"] == "reread"]
    assert ev[0]["changes"][0]["new"] == 99 and ev[0]["changes"][0]["kept"] == "old"
    assert ev[1]["changes"][0]["kept"] == "new"
    assert_status_rule(led)


def test_row_total_misread_is_fixed_by_rereading_the_total_not_the_cells():
    led = Ledger()
    make_block(led, 1, "p1-b1", row_totals={"EARLY": 35})        # printed EARLY total misread: 35 for 30
    seen = []
    def decide(prompt, n):
        seen.append(prompt)
        return {"action": "reread", "rereads": [{"target": {"kind": "row_total", "row": "EARLY"}, "dpi": 400,
                                                 "model": HAIKU}]}
    s, gw, geo = run(led, decide, lambda b, t, m, n: {"value": 30})
    assert "look at the row's printed total first" in seen[0]
    assert [t[1]["kind"] for t in geo.targets] == ["row_total"]
    assert {c["status"] for c in led.cells("x")} == {"accepted"}
    assert all(c["value"] == c["first_read"] for c in led.cells("x"))
    assert_status_rule(led)


def test_small_total_hint_when_the_rows_pass():
    led = Ledger()
    make_block(led, 1, "p1-b1", col_totals={"1": 99})
    seen = []
    def decide(prompt, n):
        seen.append(prompt)
        return {"action": "cannot_verify", "reason": "test"}
    run(led, decide, truth_reader())
    assert "look at the small total first" in seen[0]


def test_six_actions_then_cannot_verify_and_the_loop_goes_on():
    led = Ledger()
    make_block(led, 1, "p1-b1", wrong={("EARLY", "1"): 16})
    make_block(led, 1, "p1-b2", wrong={("EARLY", "2"): 21})
    stuck = lambda bid, t, m, n: ({"EARLY": 16, "ABSENTEE": 2, "PRECINCT": 3, "total": 15} if bid == "p1-b1"
                                  else {"EARLY": 20, "ABSENTEE": 4, "PRECINCT": 6, "total": 30})
    def decide(prompt, n):
        col = "1" if "p1-b1" in prompt else "2"
        return reread_col(col, model=HAIKU)
    s, gw, geo = run(led, decide, stuck)
    first = [t for t in geo.targets if t[0] == "p1-b1"]
    assert len(first) == 6
    stat = {(c["block_id"], c["row_kind"], c["column"]): c["status"] for c in led.cells("x")}
    assert stat[("p1-b1", "EARLY", "1")] == "cannot_verify"
    assert all(v == "accepted" for k, v in stat.items() if k[0] == "p1-b2")
    stops = [json.loads(e["payload_json"]) for e in led.events("x") if e["kind"] == "stop"]
    assert any("six actions" in p["reason"] for p in stops)
    assert s["cells_cannot_verify"] == 2 + 0 or s["cells_cannot_verify"] >= 1
    assert_status_rule(led)


def test_a_decision_may_list_several_rereads_and_they_count_one_each():
    led = Ledger()
    make_block(led, 1, "p1-b1", wrong={("EARLY", "1"): 16})
    many = {"action": "reread", "rereads": [{"target": {"kind": "cell", "row": "EARLY", "column": "1"},
                                             "dpi": 300, "model": HAIKU}] * 8}
    s, gw, geo = run(led, lambda p, n: many if n == 0 else {"action": "done"},
                     lambda b, t, m, n: {"value": 16})
    assert len(geo.targets) == 6


def test_stronger_model_is_refused_until_two_haiku_rereads_failed():
    led = Ledger()
    make_block(led, 1, "p1-b1", wrong={("EARLY", "1"): 16})
    plan = [reread_col("1", model=SONNET), reread_col("1"), reread_col("1"), reread_col("1", model=SONNET)]
    def read(bid, t, model, n):
        e, a, p = GOOD["1"]
        return {"EARLY": 16 if model == HAIKU else 10, "ABSENTEE": a, "PRECINCT": p, "total": e + a + p}
    s, gw, geo = run(led, lambda p, n: plan[min(n, 3)], read)
    models = [m for m, k, _ in gw.log if k == "read"]
    assert models == [HAIKU, HAIKU, SONNET]            # the first Sonnet request never reached the model
    refused = [json.loads(e["payload_json"]) for e in led.events("x") if e["kind"] == "refused"]
    assert len(refused) == 1 and "two re-reads" in refused[0]["reason"]
    assert {c["status"] for c in led.cells("x")} == {"accepted"}


def test_check_model_rule_directly():
    item = agent.Item("row", 1, "b", "EARLY")
    with pytest.raises(agent.StrongModelRefused):
        agent.check_model(item, SONNET)
    item.weak_failures = 2
    agent.check_model(item, SONNET)
    agent.check_model(item, HAIKU)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        agent.check_model(item, "some-other-model")


def test_resume_never_asks_about_accepted_cells():
    led = Ledger()
    make_block(led, 1, "p1-b1")                                    # holds: will be accepted
    make_block(led, 1, "p1-b2", wrong={("EARLY", "1"): 16})
    agent.derive_status(led, "x")
    assert {c["status"] for c in led.cells("x") if c["block_id"] == "p1-b1"} == {"accepted"}
    s, gw, geo = run(led, lambda p, n: reread_col("1"), truth_reader())
    assert all(t[0] == "p1-b2" for t in geo.targets)
    assert all("p1-b1" not in m[2] for m in gw.log if m[1] == "decide")
    # a second close over the finished ledger asks nothing at all
    s2, gw2, geo2 = run(led, lambda p, n: pytest.fail("asked"), lambda *a: pytest.fail("read"))
    assert gw2.calls == 0


def test_rereading_an_accepted_cell_is_refused_by_code():
    led = Ledger()
    make_block(led, 1, "p1-b1", wrong={("EARLY", "1"): 16})
    cell = {"action": "reread", "rereads": [{"target": {"kind": "cell", "row": "ABSENTEE", "column": "2"},
                                             "dpi": 300, "model": HAIKU}]}
    # ABSENTEE col 2 sits on passing sums, so it is accepted at the start and must not be re-read
    s, gw, geo = run(led, lambda p, n: cell if n == 0 else {"action": "cannot_verify", "reason": "no"},
                     truth_reader())
    assert geo.targets == []
    assert any(e["kind"] == "refused" for e in led.events("x"))


def test_max_items_leaves_the_rest_open():
    led = Ledger()
    make_block(led, 1, "p1-b1", wrong={("EARLY", "1"): 16})
    make_block(led, 1, "p1-b2", wrong={("EARLY", "2"): 21})
    s, gw, geo = run(led, lambda p, n: reread_col("1" if "p1-b1" in p else "2"), truth_reader(), max_items=1)
    open_ = [c for c in led.cells("x") if c["status"] not in ("accepted", "cannot_verify")]
    assert open_ and all(c["block_id"] == "p1-b2" for c in open_)


def test_unusable_decision_marks_the_item_cannot_verify():
    led = Ledger()
    make_block(led, 1, "p1-b1", wrong={("EARLY", "1"): 16})
    s, gw, geo = run(led, lambda p, n: {"action": "dance"}, truth_reader())
    assert_status_rule(led)
    assert s["cells_cannot_verify"] > 0


def test_every_cell_is_closed_one_way_or_the_other():
    led = Ledger()
    make_block(led, 1, "p1-b1", wrong={("EARLY", "1"): 16})
    s, gw, geo = run(led, lambda p, n: {"action": "cannot_verify", "reason": "cannot see it"}, truth_reader())
    assert_status_rule(led)
    assert {c["status"] for c in led.cells("x") if c["column"] == "1" and c["row_kind"] == "EARLY"} == {"cannot_verify"}


def test_enlarge_makes_digits_at_least_40_px():
    assert agent.scale_for(300, "cell") * agent.digit_px(300, "cell") >= 40
    assert agent.scale_for(400, "col_total") * agent.digit_px(400, "col_total") >= 40
    assert agent.scale_for(400, "cell") >= 1


def test_county_json_has_the_documented_fields(tmp_path):
    led = Ledger()
    make_block(led, 1, "p1-b1", wrong={("EARLY", "1"): 16})
    s, gw, geo = run(led, lambda p, n: reread_col("1"), truth_reader())
    out = outputs.write_county(tmp_path, "x", "run1", led, FakeGeo(), s, pages=[])
    d = json.loads(out.read_text())
    for k in ("county", "run_id", "layout", "pages", "blocks", "cells", "totals", "checks", "events", "summary"):
        assert k in d
    assert {"page", "block", "row_kind", "column", "value", "first_read", "status", "tries", "model", "box"} <= set(d["cells"][0])
    assert {"kind", "page", "block", "key", "terms", "printed", "computed", "ok"} <= set(d["checks"][0])
    assert {"ts", "kind", "payload"} <= set(d["events"][0])


def test_mask_replaces_images_with_a_short_reference():
    import base64, io
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    Image.new("L", (30, 20), 200).save(buf, format="PNG")
    url = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()
    span = {"name": "x", "input": [{"content": [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": url}}, "text"]}],
            "attributes": {"k": url}}
    out = tracing.mask_images(span)
    ref = out["input"][0]["content"][0]["image_url"]["url"]
    assert ref.startswith("image 30x20 sha256:") and len(ref.split("sha256:")[1]) == 12
    assert out["attributes"]["k"] == ref and "base64" not in json.dumps(out)
    assert out["input"][0]["content"][1] == "text"


def test_two_rereads_that_agree_win_a_tie():
    led = Ledger()
    # EARLY col 1 and col 2 both wrong, so fixing one cell alone changes no count of holding sums
    make_block(led, 1, "p1-b1", wrong={("EARLY", "1"): 16, ("EARLY", "2"): 25})
    seq = iter([("1", 11), ("1", 11)])
    def read(bid, t, model, n):
        e, a, p = GOOD[t["column"]]
        return {"EARLY": 11 if t["column"] == "1" else 25, "ABSENTEE": a, "PRECINCT": p, "total": e + a + p}
    s, gw, geo = run(led, lambda p, n: reread_col("1") if n < 2 else {"action": "cannot_verify", "reason": "x"}, read)
    ev = [json.loads(e["payload_json"]) for e in led.events("x") if e["kind"] == "reread"]
    assert [x["changes"][0]["kept"] for x in ev] == ["old", "new"]


def test_decision_prompt_names_crossing_cells():
    led = Ledger()

"""neatlogs setup and span helpers. Everything here is a no-op when NEATLOGS_API_KEY is absent."""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import contextlib
import hashlib
import io
import os
import re

try:
    import neatlogs
except ImportError:  # the package is a dependency, but a broken install must not stop a run
    neatlogs = None

_on = False


_IMAGE = re.compile(r"data:image/[A-Za-z0-9.+-]+;base64,[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+")


def _image_ref(m: re.Match) -> str:
    raw = base64.b64decode(m.group(0).split(",", 1)[1] + "===")
    try:
        from PIL import Image
        with Image.open(io.BytesIO(raw)) as im:
            size = f"{im.width}x{im.height}"
    except Exception:
        size = "?x?"
    return f"image {size} sha256:{hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()[:12]}"


def mask_images(obj):
    """neatlogs mask: replace every data:image base64 string anywhere in a span with a short reference."""
    if isinstance(obj, str):
        return _IMAGE.sub(_image_ref, obj)
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        return {k: mask_images(v) for k, v in obj.items()}
    if isinstance(obj, (list, tuple)):
        return [mask_images(v) for v in obj]
    return obj


def init() -> str:
    """Start tracing if the key is present. Returns the line to print first when it is not."""
    global _on
    if neatlogs is None or not os.environ.get("NEATLOGS_API_KEY"):
        _on = False
        return "NEATLOGS_API_KEY is not set: running untraced."
    neatlogs.init(api_key=os.environ["NEATLOGS_API_KEY"], workflow_name="crossfoot", mask=mask_images)
    _on = True
    return ""


def enabled() -> bool:
    return _on


def wrap(client):
    return neatlogs.wrap(client) if _on else client

import json

import pytest
from PIL import Image

from crossfoot import agent, outputs, tracing
from crossfoot.ledger import Ledger

ROWS = ("EARLY", "ABSENTEE", "PRECINCT")
GOOD = {"1": (10, 2, 3), "2": (20, 4, 6)}     # column -> EARLY, ABSENTEE, PRECINCT
HAIKU, SONNET = "claude-haiku", "claude-sonnet-4.6"


def make_block(led, page, bid, good=GOOD, wrong=None, row_totals=None, col_totals=None, grand=None):
    """A block whose printed totals are those of `good`; `wrong` maps (row, column) -> the value the first read gave."""
    wrong = wrong or {}
    for col, vals in good.items():
        for r, v in zip(ROWS, vals):
            led.put_cell("x", page, bid, r, col, wrong.get((r, col), v), contest="C", candidate=f"cand {bid}")
        led.put_total("x", page, bid, "col", col, (col_totals or {}).get(col, sum(vals)))
    for i, r in enumerate(ROWS):
        led.put_total("x", page, bid, "row", r, (row_totals or {}).get(r, sum(v[i] for v in good.values())))
    led.put_total("x", page, bid, "grand", "", grand if grand is not None else sum(sum(v) for v in good.values()))


class FakeGeo:
    def __init__(self):
        self.targets = []

    def crop(self, page, bid, target, dpi, dest):
        self.targets.append((bid, dict(target), dpi))
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        Image.new("L", (10, 10), 255).save(dest)
        return dest, (0, 0, 10, 10)

    def total_box(self, page, bid, direction, key):
        return None

    def block_box(self, page, bid):
        return None


class FakeGw:
    """Decisions come from `decide(prompt, n)`, re-reads from `read(target, model, n)`. Logs every call."""
    def __init__(self, geo, decide, read, model=HAIKU):
        self.geo, self.decide, self.read, self.model = geo, decide, read, model
        self.calls = self.prompt_tokens = self.completion_tokens = 0
        self.cost = 0.0
        self.log = []

    def ask_json(self, prompt, image=None, *, validate=None, model=None):
        self.calls += 1
        model = model or self.model
        if image is None:
            ans = self.decide(prompt, sum(1 for m, k, _ in self.log if k == "decide"))
            self.log.append((model, "decide", prompt))
        else:
            bid, target, dpi = self.geo.targets[-1]
            ans = self.read(bid, target, model, sum(1 for m, k, _ in self.log if k == "read"))
            self.log.append((model, "read", (bid, target, dpi)))
        if validate:
            validate(ans)
        return ans


def reread_col(col, model=HAIKU, dpi=300):
    return {"action": "reread", "rereads": [{"target": {"kind": "column", "column": col}, "dpi": dpi, "model": model}]}


def truth_reader(good=GOOD):
    def read(bid, t, model, n):
        if t["kind"] == "column":
            e, a, p = good[t["column"]]
            return {"EARLY": e, "ABSENTEE": a, "PRECINCT": p, "total": e + a + p}
        if t["kind"] == "cell":
            return {"value": good[t["column"]][ROWS.index(t["row"])]}
        raise AssertionError(t)
    return read


def run(led, decide, read, **kw):
    geo = FakeGeo()
    gw = FakeGw(geo, decide, read)
    s = agent.close_county("x", gw, led, geo, run_id="", log=lambda *a: None, **kw)
    return s, gw, geo


def assert_status_rule(led):
    """AC-1: no accepted cell sits on a failing printed sum, and every cell ends accepted or cannot_verify."""
    from crossfoot import checks
    cells, totals = led.cells("x"), led.totals("x")
    bad = {k for ch in checks.row_checks(cells, totals) + checks.column_checks(cells, totals) if not ch.ok
           for k, _ in ch.terms}
    for c in cells:
        assert c["status"] in ("accepted", "cannot_verify"), c
        if c["status"] == "accepted":
            assert checks.cell_key(c) not in bad

"""neatlogs setup and span helpers. Everything here is a no-op when NEATLOGS_API_KEY is absent."""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import contextlib
import hashlib
import io
import os
import re

try:
    import neatlogs
except ImportError:  # the package is a dependency, but a broken install must not stop a run
    neatlogs = None

_on = False


_IMAGE = re.compile(r"data:image/[A-Za-z0-9.+-]+;base64,[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+")


def _image_ref(m: re.Match) -> str:
    raw = base64.b64decode(m.group(0).split(",", 1)[1] + "===")
    try:
        from PIL import Image
        with Image.open(io.BytesIO(raw)) as im:
            size = f"{im.width}x{im.height}"
    except Exception:
        size = "?x?"
    return f"image {size} sha256:{hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()[:12]}"


def mask_images(obj):
    """neatlogs mask: replace every data:image base64 string anywhere in a span with a short reference."""
    if isinstance(obj, str):
        return _IMAGE.sub(_image_ref, obj)
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        return {k: mask_images(v) for k, v in obj.items()}
    if isinstance(obj, (list, tuple)):
        return [mask_images(v) for v in obj]
    return obj


def init() -> str:
    """Start tracing if the key is present. Returns the line to print first when it is not."""
    global _on
    if neatlogs is None or not os.environ.get("NEATLOGS_API_KEY"):
        _on = False
        return "NEATLOGS_API_KEY is not set: running untraced."
    neatlogs.init(api_key=os.environ["NEATLOGS_API_KEY"], workflow_name="crossfoot", mask=mask_images)
    _on = True
    return ""


def enabled() -> bool:
    return _on


def wrap(client):
    return neatlogs.wrap(client) if _on else client
